In your 20s, money mistakes rarely feel like mistakes — they feel normal, justified, even earned. In this video, Aastha Khurana shares a perspective on the quiet financial decisions that shape the next 10–15 years of your life and why awareness matters more than income in the early years. This is not about extreme saving, but about building habits, clarity, and systems before responsibilities grow. If you’re in your 20s, this might change how you think about money going forward.
